lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct vertical white lines observed. Spacing is widest in the center of the torso mass and becomes progressively narrower towards the anterior shoulder and posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the fourth line from the posterior end, where the line splits into two separate segments as it descends towards the ventral region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first two anterior lines and the final three posterior lines consist of abbreviated or dashed segments that do not reach the dorsal or ventral boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of 5 distinct high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, centered above the knee joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the posterior-most edge of the haunch align vertically, creating a semi-connected linear pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron pattern across the bridge of the muzzle; two white patches on the lower throat region; distinct white horizontal banding on the carpal and tarsal regions of all four limbs.
